text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...That was an amazing race. My heart is 
still racing.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's not true at all! This race is 
real, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's not a dream... and it's not an 
illusion.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. And that is precisely why the road 
stretches ever onward.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Please run as far as your heart desires! 
Because I... want to stay by your side 
forever and watch your brilliance."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm looking forward to the next race 
as well!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"You should be able to run anywhere! If 
it's you and <chrname>, Trainer, I know the two of 
you can...!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll be rooting for you in your next 
race too!
